goal: Measure causal Flow transport with six ordinary implementation features.

plan.overview: Exercise plan, approval, feature start, completion, compact status, reviewer context, and unchanged polling using deterministic local state.
requirements: Bind validation and review evidence to each source snapshot.
Return metadata only when polling an unchanged revision.
decisions: Use immutable evidence and reviewer packet digests.

features.title: Causal identities
features.summary: Record revision, snapshot, and operation identities for committed mutations without changing feature semantics.

features.title: Compact projections
features.summary: Expose bounded compact, detail, and reviewer projections with a single canonical active-or-next feature reference.

features.title: Mutation receipts
features.summary: Return bounded mutation receipts instead of attaching the complete durable session to ordinary model-visible responses.
validation: Run receipt size and schema tests.

features.title: Delta polling
features.summary: Return unchanged metadata for equal revisions and bounded ordered deltas for older valid revisions.

features.title: Evidence artifacts
features.summary: Persist restricted evidence artifacts atomically and verify their hash-addressed identities before state mutation.
validation: Run evidence crash and integrity tests.

features.title: Transport acceptance gates
features.summary: Measure compactness and transition parity locally while leaving unavailable investigation-corpus metrics explicitly null.
validation: Run the deterministic report and full project gate.
